tagline: Dive into BETA's Ocean LAN party, get tickets below!

chart.title: The Drowned Chart of BetaLAN
chart.p1: Hauled dripping from the wreck of the **S.S. Kernel**, this salt-stained chart marks the last bearing of BetaLAN's lost hoard, swallowed when the ship went down off the **Bluebox Reef**.
chart.p2: The wreck is coiled by **Deadlock, the Drowned Leviathan** — a serpent of tangled cable and barnacled steel that sleeps in the dark and wakes for any who disturb its hoard.
chart.p3: Chart a course through its three trials and live, and the treasure in the hold is yours to raise.

crew.title: Crew Information
crew.text:
